setupBody: This page checks the server, then loads data from files or the web.
unreadableResponse: The server sent an answer the app cannot read.
serverNotAnswering: The server did not answer. Check that corpus-kb is running.
unknownOperation: That operation is not in the manifest.
unavailableBody: The server cannot run this yet. You can retry in a moment.
runnerUnknownOutcome: The connection dropped. The server may still be working.
runnerCancelled: You stopped waiting. The op may still run on the server.
runnerStatusEmpty: The server sent no status message.
runnerParamsHint: The request fields go here as JSON.
confirmLongBody: This can take minutes. You can stop waiting at any time.
badgeDegradeNote: Thresholds were missing, so the answer is not verified.
stagePlaceholderBody: This stage arrives with the next update. Use Setup to load data first.
setupDoctorDbDown: The database is not reachable. Ingest and search will not work.
setupDoctorOllamaDown: The model server is not reachable. Ingest ends with weak embeddings. Ask shows sources without an answer.
setupDoctorChecksNone: The database checks did not run. Fix the database first.
setupDemoBody: Load five short sample files through the standard pipeline. This fills the library for a first try.
setupDemoConfirmBody: This can take a minute. Files already loaded are skipped.
setupUploadBody: Pick files from this machine. They go through the standard ingest pipeline.
setupUploadCap: Each file can be up to {mb} MB.
setupUploadTooLarge: That file is over the {mb} MB cap. Pick a smaller file.
setupIngestTitle: Ingest from the server or the web
setupIngestDirTitle: Ingest a folder on the server
setupIngestDirBody: Ingest every supported file under one folder. The folder must exist on the machine that runs corpus-kb.
setupIngestUrlBody: Fetch one web page, or crawl pages on the same domain.
reviewBody: Check the corpus health, review coded units, and browse the discovered topics.
reviewDocsNotWired: The document list is not wired yet. The server manifest has no read route for documents.
reviewDegradedNone: No degraded chunks. Every stored chunk has a vector.
reviewDegradedCounts: {chunks} chunks and {vectors} vectors lack usable embeddings. Re-embed them now, or when the model server is back.
reviewQueueBody: Confirm or overrule the model assignments, one row at a time.
reviewQueueEmpty: No assignments wait for review. Run a coding pipeline first, or go on to Ask.
reviewReviewerHint: Your name is saved in this browser and sent with each decision.
reviewOverrideBody: Your decision and note replace the model assignment. The model answer stays on record.
reviewNoteRequired: A note is required to override.
askBody: One question in, a cited answer out. Every sentence points at its source.
askEmptyState: No evidence matched this question. Try other words, or add documents first.
askDegradedState: Answer generation is unavailable. Showing the source text without an answer.
askDegradedExcluded: {count} chunks were left out of the search because an index is impaired.
askHistoryEmpty: No questions yet in this session.
askVerifyNotWired: The verify check is not wired yet. The server manifest has no verify operation.
askSearchSimilarNotWired: Find-similar is not wired yet. The server manifest has no similar-search operation.
askSearchContextNotWired: Context search is not wired yet. The server manifest has no context-search operation.
analyzeBody: Run the guided analysis methods, or pick one from the advisor's ranking.
analyzeAdvisorBody: State the task in one sentence. The advisor ranks the register's methods for it.
analyzeHumanOnly: This method runs with people, outside the app.
analyzeMethodNotWired: This method's app operation is not wired yet.
analyzeRunnerBody: Pick a method, check its request fields, then run it.
analyzeStatementsNotWired: Statements are not wired yet. The server manifest has no statement operations.
analyzeConflictsNotWired: Conflict scan and resolve are not wired yet. The server manifest has no conflict operations.
analyzeBeliefsNotWired: Belief timelines and predictions are not wired yet. The server manifest has no belief operations.
analyzeEmbedMetaNotWired: Embed metadata is not wired yet. The server manifest has no embed-meta operation.
analyzeExtractionTuneNotWired: Extraction tuning is not wired yet. The server manifest has no extraction-tune operation.
analyzeTopicsBuildBody: Cluster the stored chunk embeddings into topics. This can take a minute.
analyzeTrendsBody: Per-topic frequency series over binned document dates.
analyzeLabelingBody: Score the labeling functions and write the aggregated chunk labels. This can take a minute.
analyzeClassificationBody: Fit the classifier against the stored weak labels. This can take a minute.
analyzeAnalyzeBody: Compose the corpus analysis and write the report. This can take a minute.
analyzeDatesBody: Fill missing document dates from chunk metadata. This is safe to run again.
analyzeDormant: This feature is off in the loaded config.
ingestBody: Pick a tab. Every tab runs the standard ingest pipeline.
ingestPasteNotWired: Paste text is not wired yet. The server manifest has no text-ingest operation.
ingestTranscriptPathLabel: Transcript file path on the server
ingestTranscriptPathRequired: Enter the transcript's server path first.
scaleBody: Watch the run ledger, bulk-load folders, and re-embed degraded chunks.
scaleLedgerBody: The ledger checks on its own while this browser tab is open.
scaleLedgerPaused: Polling pauses while this browser tab is hidden.
scaleLedgerBackoff: The server did not answer. Retrying every 10 seconds.
scaleResearchBody: Ingest one file, folder, or glob. The ledger skips files it already has.
scaleForceWarning: Force re-ingests files the ledger already has. This can take a long time.
codebookBody: Check the pre-flight, run the coding steps, promote proposed codes, and read the notebook views.
codebookPreFlightBody: The research projects, the codebook versions, and the embedding check from the system status.
codebookVersionsNone: No codebook versions yet. Run a coding step first.
codebookDimsNone: The embedding rows did not run. Check the system status page.
codebookInductiveBody: Summaries, clusters, and proposed codes from the corpus. This can take a minute.
codebookRunBody: Score the codebook against the units with calibrated thresholds. This can take a minute.
codebookVersionRequired: Enter a codebook version id first.
codebookEmbedNotWired: Codebook embedding is not wired yet. The manifest has no embed-codebook operation.
codebookPoolNotWired: Prototype pooling is not wired yet. The manifest has no pool operation.
codebookBatchNotWired: The code batch is not wired yet. The manifest has no batch operation.
codebookCalibrateNotWired: Floor calibration is not wired yet. The manifest has no calibrate operation.
codebookReliabilityNotWired: Reliability is not wired yet. The manifest has no reliability operation.
codebookSaturationNotWired: Saturation is not wired yet. The manifest has no saturation operation.
codebookPromoteBody: One proposal becomes a new codebook version. Only a person promotes.
codebookPromoteDuplicate: The duplicate gate blocked this proposal. Merge suggestion:
codebookPromoteDone: Promoted into a new codebook version.
codebookProposalsNone: No proposed codes yet. Run the inductive pass first.
codebookUncodedBody: Rank the units that no code covers.
codebookOverlapBody: Flagged pairs, confusion, and borderline-margin units.
codebookGovernanceBody: One schema-pinned report over the current evidence.
codebookCycleBody: One stage per click. The cycle never approves for you.
codebookCycleUnavailable: Embeddings are unavailable. Check the model server, then run the next stage.
codebookCycleHalted: A gate stopped the run. Do the gate's work yourself, then run the next stage.
codebookCycleAwaiting: The run waits for a person to approve it.
codebookCycleDenied: Approval was denied. The run stopped.
releaseBody: Assess the gates, open the draft, review the packet, and execute with an approver.
releaseAssessBody: Compose every gate over the current evidence. Nothing is written.
releaseAllPass: Every required gate passes without waivers.
